```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_revealjs/contents.sha.qmd",
  stem = "contents",
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(siteID.target = NULL, TITLE = "Contents"),
  root = root
)
invisible(lapply(seq_len(nrow(SiteTable)), function(i) {
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/seismicity.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "seismicity", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteTable$siteID[[i]],
      TITLE = sprintf("Regional Seismicity<br>Site: %s", SiteTable$label[[i]])
    ),
    root = root
  )
}))
if (!is.null(GMPETable) && nrow(GMPETable)) {
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/gmm.qmd",
    stem = "gmm",
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = NULL,
      TITLE = "Ground Motion Models"
    ),
    root = root
  )
}
invisible(lapply(seq_len(nrow(SiteTable)), function(i) {
  SiteID <- SiteTable$siteID[[i]]
  SiteLabel <- SiteTable$label[[i]]

  if (nrow(SiteTable) > 1L) {
    NGR::knitBlock(
      path = "/_revealjs/contents.sha.qmd",
      stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "contents", sep = "-"),
      labels = "rewrite",
      vars = list(
        siteID.target = SiteID,
        TITLE = sprintf("Contents<br>Site: %s", SiteLabel)
      ),
      root = root
    )
  }
  SiteLabel <- paste0("<br>Site: ", SiteLabel)
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/hazard.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "hazard", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = paste0("Seismic Hazard (PSHA)", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/disagg.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "disagg", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = paste0("Hazard Deaggregation", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
  if (!is.null(MCETable) && nrow(MCETable)) {
    NGR::knitBlock(
      path = "/_revealjs/mce.qmd",
      stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "mce", sep = "-"),
      labels = "rewrite",
      vars = list(
        siteID.target = SiteID,
        TITLE = paste0("Seismic Hazard (DSHA)", SiteLabel)
      ),
      root = root
    )
  }
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/hazard.compare.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "hazard-compare", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = paste0("Design Spectra (PSHA/DSHA)", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/uhs.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "uhs", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = paste0("Site Response Spectra (PSHA/DSHA)", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/af.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "af", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = paste0("Site Amplification (AF)", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
}))
```
